entries.name: Nagathoria
entries.content: Nagathoria is a monarchy mostly ruled by Lamia. Although humans and other demihumans do exist they are generally considered to be second class citizens, though a few have managed to achieve royal status. Nagathoria is ruled by the Council, who use the Royal family as a figurehead for their decisions.

entries.name: The Council
entries.content: The true rulers of Nagathoria. This group of high ranking individuals exist to ensure stability and pass laws for Nagathoria. The Council uses the royal family as a figurehead.
